name: Biomedical Sciences PhD (College of Medicine)
summary: Biomedical sciences doctoral training with three first-year research rotations and five curricular emphasis areas.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Formal application
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated application deadline; Fall 2027 interviews are posted separately.

publishedDeadlines.label: Supporting documents, including reference letters
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated supporting-material deadline; no year assigned.

english.note: TOEFL/IELTS if applicable; official scores sent directly from testing agency. Provisional admission not offered. Current central thresholds inaccessible.

applicationFee.note: International fee $85; U.S. applicants $65. No waiver offer on opened program pages; central page blocked.

documents: Uploaded copies of official transcripts from all colleges/universities
Personal statement (up to two pages): motivation, research experiences, interests, goals and program fit
requirements.note: Bachelor's or higher in science-related major or foreign equivalent. Other backgrounds may apply; minimum preparation includes biology, chemistry, organic chemistry, biochemistry and molecular biology or genetics.

timeline.interviews: Fall 2027 on-campus interviews February 3–5 and February 18–20, 2027. Applicants currently outside U.S. interview virtually.

funding.note: Admitted students appointed research assistants with stipend, tuition and insurance. University pays 80% of medical/dental/vision cost. Program supports first four semesters; dissertation advisor then responsible with departmental guarantee. Published stipend rate is 2026–27, not Fall 2027.
